DescriptionAdlsGen2BlobSnapshots: If enabled, snapshot related features will be shown for ADLS Gen2 storage accounts. Snapshot features will only work for storage accounts which are enrolled in the snapshots preview. Storage Explorer must be restarted for this setting to be applied.
DescriptionAutoDownloadUpdates: If enabled, Storage Explorer will automatically download updates when available. Storage Explorer must be restarted for this setting to be applied. This setting does not apply to Snap installs of Storage Explorer.
DescriptionAutoLogout: If enabled, you will automatically be signed out when Storage Explorer exits.
DescriptionAutoRefresh: If enabled, data explorers will automatically refresh after operations which affect the data they are displaying are completed.
DescriptionDefaultDownload: Determines the default location Storage Explorer uses when opening the save file dialog for downloads. Modifying this setting temporarily overrides the most recently used path.
DescriptionDisableStorageAccountKeyUsage: When checked, Storage Explorer will not use the account keys of Storage Accounts under subscriptions. All data explorer tabs must be closed, and Storage Explorer restarted, for this setting to be applied.
DescriptionDisableTrailingDotSupport: When checked, Storage Explorer will no longer support file share files or folders having trailing dots in their name. This may result in trailing dots being dropped from file or folder names during certain operations.
DescriptionEnableAzureDataFactory: If unchecked, then all Azure Data Factory related features will be hidden. Storage Explorer must be restarted for this setting to be applied.
DescriptionEnableDisks: If unchecked, then all Disk related features will be hidden. The tree view must be refreshed for this setting to be applied.
DescriptionEnableStorageAccounts: If unchecked, then all Storage Account related features will be hidden. The tree view must be refreshed for this setting to be applied.
DescriptionGlobalSort: If enabled, all available data will be loaded when sorting items by column, even if Load All is disabled.
DescriptionLoadAll: If enabled, load more will load all available data instead of just the next batch.
DescriptionLoadBatchSize: The minimum number of items to load per batch when a batch of data is loaded. If set, data will continue loading until at least the configured number of items have been retrieved. If not set, each service will use its default batch size.
DescriptionLogLevel: The log verbosity level for Storage Explorer. Options are ordered from least to most verbose. Logs can be viewed by going to Help > Open Logs Directory. Storage Explorer must be restarted for this setting to be applied.
DescriptionNaturalSort: If enabled, items will be sorted in natural order. For example, 'file2.txt' will come before 'file10.txt'. If disabled, items will be sorted in lexicographical order. For example, 'file10.txt' will come before 'file2.txt'.
DescriptionOpenOperation:
The operation to perform when opening a blob or file, either via double-click or the Enter key.

If set to 'Open in External Program', the file will be downloaded and opened in your system's default application for the file's type.

If set to 'Preview' and in-app preview supports the file's type, the file will be previewed in-app. If in-app preview does not support the file's type, the behavior for 'Open in External Program' will be used.
DescriptionPreserveTabSession: If enabled, your data explorers will be preserved on close, and be restored on restart.
DescriptionProxy:
Use these settings to customize how Storage Explorer communicates with a proxy server.

Changes to proxy settings will not affect operations currently in progress. For example, AzCopy jobs that are in progress will keep using the old proxy settings until they finish.

Storage Explorer will always bypass the proxy server when sending requests to the local host, regardless of proxy settings.
DescriptionProxyAutoManageProxySettings: When enabled, Storage Explorer may automatically change proxy settings to facilitate successful networking. Disable this setting if you want to manually set proxy settings without automatic modification.
DescriptionProxyHostname: Custom proxy hostname. This setting is only used if the proxy configuration is set to read from app proxy settings.
DescriptionProxyNoProxy:
A list of hostnames or patterns that should bypass the proxy server. If the hostname of a request matches any of these entries, Storage Explorer will not send the request through the proxy server. This setting is only used if the proxy configuration is set to read from app proxy settings.

Entries may specify a single hostname (ex. 'mydomain.contoso.com') or a hostname pattern (ex. '.contoso.com').

When modifying this setting, use JSON array syntax (ex. '[".consto.com", ".blob.core.windows.net"]').
DescriptionProxyPort: Custom proxy port. This setting is only used if the proxy configuration is set to read from app proxy settings.
DescriptionProxyProtocol: Custom proxy protocol. This setting is only used if the proxy configuration is set to read from app proxy settings.
DescriptionProxySource:
Select how Storage Explorer determines the proxy configuration.

If using environment variables, Storage Explorer will determine the proxy configuration based on the HTTPS_PROXY, HTTP_PROXY, and NO_PROXY environment variables.

If using app proxy settings, Storage Explorer will get the proxy configuration from the Protocol, Hostname, and Port app settings.

If using system proxy, Storage Explorer will get the proxy configuration from the system proxy settings.
DescriptionProxyUseCredentials:
If enabled, Storage Explorer will use a stored username and password to authenticate with a proxy. The stored username and password are only used if the proxy configuration is set to read from app settings.

A username and password can be specified in the Proxy Settings dialog (Edit → Configure Proxy).
DescriptionProxyUseProxy: Enable proxy. Storage Explorer must be restarted for this setting to be applied.
DescriptionRegionalLanguage: Select the preferred application language. Storage Explorer must be restarted for this setting to be applied.
DescriptionSafeFileExtensions:
Storage Explorer will not prompt for confirmation when opening files with a trusted extension.

When modifying this setting, use JSON array syntax (ex. '[".docx",".txt"]'). To trust files without an extension, you can add "" to the trusted extensions array.

Files with a trusted extension may still be unsafe to open. Only open files from sources you trust.
DescriptionShowMetricsTables: If enabled, tables used to store storage service metrics (such as '$MetricsHourPrimaryTransactionBlob') will be fetched when listing tables. The tree view must be refreshed for this setting to be applied.
DescriptionShowResourceGroups: If enabled, ARM resources such as storage accounts will be organized by resource group in the tree view. The tree view must be refreshed for this setting to be applied.
DescriptionSignInVerboseLogging: Enables verbose logging for authentication. For more information about how and when to use this setting, refer to the Storage Explorer troubleshooting guide (Help → Troubleshooting Guide). Storage Explorer must be restarted for this setting to be applied.
DescriptionSignInWithNotWindows: Select where and how you want sign-in to be performed. It is recommended to use your default web browser.
DescriptionSignInWithWindows: Select where and how you want sign-in to be performed. It is recommended to use the authentication broker.
DescriptionSoftDeleteConfirmation: If enabled, deleting blobs will not prompt for enabling soft delete.
DescriptionStorageTrailingAction: Determines what action will show after a group of storage nodes. Choosing "Load more" enables loading more resources in the tree view. Choosing "View all" enables viewing all resources in a separate view. The tree view must be refreshed for this setting to be applied. Currently only supported for blob container nodes.
DescriptionToolbarSize: The size of toolbars in data explorers. If set to 'Auto', toolbar size will change based on available space. If set to a specific size, toolbar size will always be that size.
DescriptionWatchFilesForChanges: If enabled, Storage Explorer will watch opened files for changes, and upon detecting changes, ask you how you would like them to be handled. File watching is only available for files opened from blob containers and file shares.
